answer: The bond is locked for 13 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the river lockup is checked by the raven escrow, the yarrow audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large swarm therefore freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants burn once per identity. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
